results.content: # What a Blind AI Translation Study Reveals About Modern Localization. Localize’s blind study shows AI translation quality is now dynamic and uneven across languages, content types, and model updates, making single-engine “set and forget” strategies risky. The takeaway for 2026 is to run a portfolio approach with automated routing and quality gates, plus continuous measurement and targeted human review to keep quality consistent as models evolve. For most of the past decade, AI translation strategy has been a relatively static decision. Teams selected a provider, often Google Translate or DeepL, configured it once, and assumed quality would steadily improve over time. New models appear all the time, performance shifts by language and content type, and quality gains in one area can coincide with regressions in another. The findings point to a fundamental shift in how localization teams should think about AI translation in 2026 and beyond. ## Why We Ran a Blind Study on AI Translation.

results.content: How AI Is Changing the Translation Service Industry in 2026. The translation service industry stands at a pivotal crossroads in 2026.
